## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Running `make test` produces **0 warnings** (currently shows `2 warnings` from `pty.py` DeprecationWarning)
- [ ] The warning filter is **test-scoped** — added to `pyproject.toml` under `[tool.pytest.ini_options]` as a `filterwarnings` entry, or as `@pytest.mark.filterwarnings` decorators on the specific spawn tests in `tests/test_terminals.py`
- [ ] The filter targets **only** the specific `DeprecationWarning` from `pty.fork()` multi-threaded fork (message pattern: `use of forkpty() may lead to deadlocks`) — not a blanket suppression of all `DeprecationWarning`
- [ ] The production code path in `src/decafclaw/terminals.py` remains **unchanged** — no `warnings.catch_warnings()` or suppression added there; the deliberate "we do NOT suppress it" decision stands
- [ ] The `pty.fork()` spawn implementation itself is **not modified**
- [ ] All existing tests in `tests/test_terminals.py` continue to pass
